overall_summary: Analysis of deduplicated YouTube Shorts data indicates that space and astronomy content—specifically extreme planetary conditions, hypothetical 'What If' scenarios involving bizarre worlds, and planetary destruction/weirdness—outperforms psychological, historical, and biological facts in both views-per-day and engagement (likes/comments-per-view) among recent 7-day uploads. Videos featuring high-stakes physical concepts like diamond planets, dark planets, and extreme weather ('raining rubies', 'burning ice') heavily drive traction compared to older or lower-engagement human biology shorts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) generated over 950-1,000+ views with high engagement (up to 38 likes) shortly after release.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on cinematic 'What If' immersion formats involving extreme extraterrestrial environments.

winning_patterns.pattern: Extreme Cosmic Anomalies & Extreme Weather Hooks
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing surreal planetary conditions such as 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) achieved strong views (700-1,000+) and robust like-to-view ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Focus future scripts on lesser-known, bizarre exoplanets with extreme physics (extreme pressure, weird rain, total darkness).

weak_patterns.evidence: Shorts centered around internal human experiences such as 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A, 5 views) and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (Jc04LVKNd2s, 17 views) showed very low velocity and engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize abstract internal psychology facts unless paired with an extreme, high-production visual hook.

weak_patterns.evidence: Simple creature facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (re-uploaded multiple times) experience diminishing returns on velocity compared to fresh space or physics concepts.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid repeating identical animal fact angles; pivot animal content toward cinematic survival or extreme evolutionary anomalies.

next_video.hook_style: Hypothetical survival question with extreme physical danger
next_video.concept: What happens if you stood on WASP-76b where daytime temperatures vaporize titanium and winds blow liquid iron sideways
